items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: Ray was part of the thriving L.A. studio scene for 35 years and found time to tour with Benny Goodman

ctx.x: Instead of crisscrossing the country on a train or in a bus. © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-
You know, even, I guess especially like with Goodman and Miller and all those guys. What were they, four weeks maybe in one place? Not for any length of time.
Some of the, like the Basie band or whatever, they’d be more one-nighters even so it had to be tough.
